escapes.name: T1 public-street escape
escapes.source_note: The corner sequence and mapped streets support a straight escape beyond T1. Width and 45 m beyond the nominal apex are estimated. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.

escapes.name: T2 public-street escape
escapes.source_note: Square corner followed by the long city straight. The continued public street is an escape with terminal buffer, not a widening of the racing line. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.

escapes.name: T15 downhill straight escape
escapes.source_note: Keep the actual downhill approach grade and separate this bounded escape from the held Niyazi upper walk and completed ordinary-island junction. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed. Bounded terminal ends before the source-qualified gymnasium/museum owner152110152; do not extend an escape into that building or replace the source museum with a shorter proxy.
